notes.title: Early Access Launch!
notes.content:
[h3]Featuring now a new playable track: Itsudatsu, the detour.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44929134/fe515cdc1123c3e5ebecc16f55d8bf63514939b1.png[/img]

Itsudatsu brings a new challenge with its offroad sector and shows us that not always the easiest way is the better one.

Don't forget to follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/turbothemoon/

I'm counting on you on this journey!

Sincerely,
[b]Steel Liege[/b]
Developer
